collapse_map_why: The two pinned further-mark points carry one class key and stand as the two members of one retained class, so one control point joins one pinned class. Route-set comparison across the two worlds is performed by this declared map and never by eye.
deletion_criterion: A pinned coordinate transfers exactly when its pinned capability sentence contains no whole word 'side' or 'sides'.

extracted.candidate_space.capability_of.admit_name: the two sides carry admitted names, so the judgment grammar of the reading gains the side-name form
extracted.candidate_space.capability_of.extra_mark: the process extends the caller's history with an admission of its own, rather than replaying only what the caller supplied and admitted
extracted.candidate_space.capability_of.keep_label: a mark's presentation label is internally available: the token forgetting of definition 14 is withdrawn
extracted.candidate_space.capability_of.withdraw_m: a mark's admission index is internally available: the metatheoretic name definition 3 assigns is declared to be an internal designation
extracted.candidate_space.capability_of.withdraw_r: the side exchange is not a permitted renaming: the two sides are declared distinguishable, which is the part of the O reading that reading U does not carry
extracted.candidate_space.exhaustive_over: the five declared coordinates and their declared values, and nothing wider.  It does not enumerate an augmentation that changes the event grammar again, that admits more than one further mark in one step, that supplies a datum the caller never presented, or that derives the permitted renamings from the judgment grammar instead of declaring them (definition 16).  Every minimality statement below is scoped to this space
extracted.measures.mu1: capability count: the number of undeclared capabilities the candidate uses
extracted.measures.mu2: collateral count: how many of the five declared facts about the retained configuration the candidate makes internally available that the same reading's base did not.  The required separation is not one of the five, but the first of them, that the two sides are internally separable, is computed to take the requirement's value at every point of the declared space, so where the base fails the requirement a satisfying candidate's count includes that one
extracted.requirement.declared: the two retained marks are internally separable under a reading exactly when no permitted automorphism of the regime carries one of them to the other
extracted.requirement.second_reading: some property of a mark that forgets whatever the candidate's declared serialization forgets, and that is invariant under every permitted renaming of the reading, holds of one retained mark and not of the other

extracted_note: Every value above is read from pinned/boundary_challenge3.json at the JSON path that is its key. A test re-reads each path from the receipt and requires equality, so a hand edit of this file fails by name.
